nodes.description: uint256 MAX_SUPPLY = 5555, hard cap of the collection
uint256 RESERVED counter for reserved/team mints, decremented on reserved mints
uint256 SEED_NONCE incremented inside hash() to vary pseudo-random input
bool _paused, public sale pause flag, defaults to true
uint256 public constant PUBLIC_MINT_PRICE = 0.03 ETH
mapping(string => bool) hashToMinted, tracks already used on-chain generated hashes
mapping(uint256 => string) tokenIdToHash, stores the 9 digit trait hash per token
mapping(address => bool) private sale whitelist gate
mapping(uint256 => Trait[]) traitTypes, trait/pixel data used for SVG and metadata
uint16[][9] TIERS, rarity distribution tables per trait category
address _owner set in constructor from msg.sender (shadowing Ownable._owner)
public payable mint entry point, takes ETH payment and mints tokens
public whitelist mint, consumes one RESERVED slot
internal mint routine: checks supply, loops minting, writes hashes
onlyOwner function transferring entire contract balance to msg.sender
onlyOwner mint against RESERVED supply
onlyOwner mint of reserved supply to an arbitrary address
onlyOwner whitelist batch update
onlyOwner pause/unpause toggle
internal hash generator using block.timestamp, block.difficulty and SEED_NONCE
internal rarity tier lookup based on _randinput and TIERS
public view returning base64 on-chain JSON metadata for a token
public view building the SVG image from the trait hash
public view enumerating token ids owned by a wallet
onlyOwner delete of trait types 3..7
onlyOwner addition of trait entries, changes SVG/metadata output
public view getter for the stored hash of a token id
msg.sender / _msgSender(), externally controlled caller address
block.timestamp used as pseudo-random seed inside hash()
mint loop with off-by-one bound (i <= _quantity) minting one extra token per call
payable(msg.sender).transfer(balance) of the full contract balance
pseudo-random trait generation from block.timestamp/block.difficulty, miner-influenceable
_quantity argument of bakePizza, user controlled mint amount
_amount argument of bakeReservedPizza/giveAway, deducted from RESERVED
to address argument of mintInternal, mint recipient
_wallet argument of walletOfOwner
whitelist calldata array of addresses to whitelist
val argument of pause, new _paused state
_to recipient argument of giveAway
_traitTypeIndex argument of addTraitType
_totalSupply snapshot captured before the mint loop in mintInternal
thisTokenId computed inside the mint loop
tokenCount of the wallet in walletOfOwner

edges.reason: Any external account can invoke bakePizza; msg.sender drives minting and payment checks
privateMint is publicly callable and authorization depends only on the _privateSaleWhitelist mapping keyed by msg.sender
bakeReservedPizza is owner-gated but mints to msg.sender, tying privileged mint to caller identity
withdrawFunds sends the whole balance to msg.sender under onlyOwner
hash() derives trait randomness from block.timestamp (miner-controllable) instead of a secure source
block.timestamp feeds the weak pseudo-randomness used to pick token traits
SEED_NONCE is incremented and packed into the keccak256 seed inside hash()
hash() calls rarityGen for each of the 9 hash digits
mintInternal invokes hash() when computing the token hash
rarityGen reads TIERS[_rarityTier] bounds to map a random input to a rarity index
bakePizza delegates the actual minting to mintInternal
privateMint delegates the actual minting to mintInternal
bakeReservedPizza delegates the actual minting to mintInternal
giveAway delegates the actual minting to mintInternal
mintInternal loop bound i <= _quantity mints _quantity+1 tokens, an off-by-one supply arithmetic bug
User-supplied _quantity directly controls the mint loop count passed into mintInternal
_quantity is the caller-supplied mint amount consumed by bakePizza
to address determines the recipient of _mint inside mintInternal
totalSupply().add(_quantity) is compared against MAX_SUPPLY to bound supply
mintInternal writes hashToMinted[hash] to mark a generated hash as used
mintInternal stores tokenIdToHash[thisTokenId] for each minted token
_amount is subtracted from RESERVED in bakeReservedPizza
_amount is subtracted from RESERVED in giveAway
RESERVED state is decremented by the reserved mint amount
RESERVED state is decremented by the giveaway amount
privateMint decrements RESERVED by 1 when consuming a whitelist slot
bakePizza compares msg.value against PUBLIC_MINT_PRICE for payment validation
bakePizza requires !_paused before allowing a public mint
_paused state read gates the bakePizza sale path
pause() is onlyOwner and mutates the sale gate _paused
val parameter sets the new _paused value
withdrawFunds transfers the full balance to msg.sender after reading balance, an external value transfer
msg.sender is the recipient of the full-balance transfer, which can re-enter if it is a contract
msg.sender is used as the key for whitelist authorization and clearing in privateMint
privateMint reads and then resets _privateSaleWhitelist[msg.sender]
whitelist array elements are written into _privateSaleWhitelist as authorized minters
updateWhitelist mutates the private sale authorization mapping
_to parameter is the mint recipient of giveAway
addTraitType is onlyOwner and appends to traitTypes, altering generated art/metadata
_traitTypeIndex selects which traitTypes array receives the new traits
clearTraits is onlyOwner and deletes traitTypes entries 3..7
tokenURI reads the token hash via _tokenIdToHash
_tokenIdToHash reads tokenIdToHash[_tokenId]
hashToSVG reads traitTypes pixel data to build the SVG
hashToSVG consumes the stored trait hash to index trait arrays
_wallet parameter is enumerated by walletOfOwner via balanceOf
tokenCount local bounds the tokenOfOwnerByIndex enumeration loop

normalization_plan.reason: _quantity is only meaningful as the caller-supplied mint amount bound to bakePizza
_amount is a reserved-supply decrement argument consumed by bakeReservedPizza
to is the internal mint recipient used directly by _mint inside mintInternal
_wallet is the enumeration target of walletOfOwner only
whitelist array is written straight into the whitelist mapping by updateWhitelist
val is the new pause state assigned by the owner-only pause function
_to is the giveaway mint recipient used by mintInternal(_to, _amount)
_traitTypeIndex selects the traitTypes slot mutated by addTraitType
_totalSupply is a mint-loop snapshot local of mintInternal
thisTokenId is the loop-computed token id written by mintInternal
tokenCount is a transient view local of walletOfOwner
